prior_rfi_responses.subject: Column Splice Detail Level 4-5
prior_rfi_responses.question_summary: Column splice at Level 4-5 transfer beam shows field-welded CJP splice, but erection sequence requires bolted splice for crane access.
prior_rfi_responses.response: Bolted splice is acceptable at this location. Use 8 - 1-1/4" A490 bolts in bearing-type connection. Splice plate thickness: 1" minimum. See revised detail on SK-S-087.
prior_rfi_responses.relevance: Establishes precedent for connection modifications at transfer beam levels

prior_rfi_responses.subject: Radiation Shielding Thickness at Imaging Suite
prior_rfi_responses.question_summary: Physics report requires 1/8 inch lead equivalent at all imaging room walls. Drawings show 1/16 inch at corridor walls.
prior_rfi_responses.response: 1/8 inch lead equivalent confirmed at ALL walls of MRI and CT suites, including corridor walls. Revised shielding plan issued. Lead-lined gypsum board required (not sheet lead overlay).
prior_rfi_responses.relevance: Establishes shielding requirements that affect RFI-103 door opening design

prior_rfi_responses.subject: HVAC Ductwork Routing Floors 15-20
prior_rfi_responses.question_summary: Ductwork conflicts with structural beams at floors 15-20. Need revised routing or beam penetration approval.
prior_rfi_responses.response: Approved beam penetrations at 6 locations per structural engineer review. Maximum penetration: 6" diameter in web of W21x50 beams. Minimum 12" from flange. Reinforcement not required for penetrations under 6". See SK-M-042.
prior_rfi_responses.relevance: Establishes beam penetration criteria that may apply to floors 18-22 (RFI-109)

prior_rfi_responses.subject: Pile Driving Vibration Limits
prior_rfi_responses.question_summary: Adjacent historic building has vibration sensitivity. Need PPV limits and monitoring requirements.
prior_rfi_responses.response: PPV limit: 0.5 in/sec at foundation of adjacent building. Continuous seismograph monitoring required within 50 ft of pile driving. Pre-construction survey of adjacent building completed and documented. If PPV exceeds 0.4 in/sec, reduce hammer energy by 25% and reassess.
prior_rfi_responses.relevance: Demonstrates approach to resolving conflicts with adjacent structures

prior_rfi_responses.subject: Asbestos Abatement Scope Expansion
prior_rfi_responses.question_summary: Additional ACM found in 2nd floor ceiling plenum not in original survey.
prior_rfi_responses.response: Revised abatement plan approved. 3-week schedule extension granted via CO-004. Additional cost: $145,000 (unit prices per contract). Contractor to submit revised Phase 2 schedule within 5 days.
prior_rfi_responses.relevance: Establishes precedent for unforeseen condition change orders at Lincoln HS (relevant to RFI-105)
